transcript.content: What's the warranty on your trekking shoes? The sole is coming off.

Acme Outdoors offers a 6-month warranty on trekking shoes for sole separation and stitching defects. To make a claim, please contact our support with your order number, a description of the defect, and clear photos. Our specialist team will review it and either repair, replace, or refund the item—this usually takes 7–10 business days.
